guidance.text: Describe the system as a state machine. STATES: each part's possible states or value range and its starting state. EVENTS: what can happen and when it counts as happening. TRANSITIONS: one bullet per rule, written 'WHEN <event> [IF <condition>] THEN <part> -> <new state or change>'. TIMING: delays and durations. UNKNOWNS: what the description leaves open.

name: STATES
notes: state machine with WHEN/IF/THEN transitions (research: explicit state tracking)
